research.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
research.subtitle: Creative Inquiry + Undergraduate Research, Clemson University, Clemson, SC
research.desc: Developed an attention-based multiple-instance learning pipeline in Dr. Rong Ge's group, mapping sparse conductance measurements to the disorder-aware periodic disorder invariant in finite, disordered Majorana nanowires. Generated ground-truth PDI phase diagrams via HPC parameter sweeps in KWANT and built the data pipeline feeding a ResNet-18 encoder trained across disorder realizations.

research.title: Summer Intern
research.subtitle: Quantum AI/ML & Optimization, Savannah River National Laboratory (SRNL), Aiken, SC
research.desc: Implemented VQE for Kitaev chain Hamiltonians in Dr. Larry Deschaine's group to resolve Majorana edge-state signatures and reproduce benchmark ground-state energies. Evaluated candidate materials using band gaps, Berry curvature, and coherence-time metrics for high-temperature operation.

research.title: Summer Intern
research.subtitle: Materials and Manufacturing Directorate, Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL), Dayton, OH
research.desc: Prepared layered AgCrP₂Se₆ samples via mechanical exfoliation in Dr. Rahul Rao's group and characterized thickness and crystal quality with AFM. Collected excitation-energy-dependent Raman and photoluminescence measurements at room and cryogenic temperatures; data published in ACS Nano (2025).

research.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
research.subtitle: Clemson Nanomaterials Institute, Clemson University, Anderson, SC
research.desc: Prepared and coated supercapacitor electrodes in Dr. Apparao Rao's group and performed cyclic voltammetry to evaluate electrochemical performance. Measured thermal diffusivity on a Linseis Laser Flash system supporting thermal characterization of novel carbon-based materials.
